Posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message. I also saved a draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) in your mailbox, subject "PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark". Nothing has been sent, so you can review it and send it yourself.

The bullets say:
- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- The saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living.
- "PHL" also refers to Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so acronym searches mix the two accounts. Use the full names.
